title: quality_control — quality checks on manufacturing/receipts L3
key_finding: quality_control, quality, and quality_mrp are all absent from Odoo Community 19.0.post20260921. Quality control is an Enterprise-only capability. The entire lifecycle — check point definition, automatic check creation on manufacturing orders and stock receipts, pass/fail and quantitative measurement recording, corrective action alerts, and confirmation blocking on failure — is implemented exclusively in Enterprise modules.
